title: Thanks and brief assist motor remarks
summary: This topic is dominated by short thank-you or name-only fragments, with only a few usable comments about driving feel, model comparison, and assist motor power.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car's good driving feel and give strong overall endorsement.

mixed.summary: The mixed review likes the car versus a Golf R Mk7 but criticizes the prior Mk8 for poor user-friendliness.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are mostly isolated thanks, names, or too-brief mentions of assist motor strength and scoring context to support clear sentiment classification.

limitations: Most fragments are too short or context-free to determine sentiment reliably.
The cluster mixes acknowledgments, personal names, and a few vehicle comments, so it is not a tightly coherent topic.
Examples are insufficient to draw broader conclusions about assist motor performance or user experience.
